field_guide.mapping: Defines all element types (terrain and interactive objects), where the key is a single-character representation of the element.
field_guide.terrain: Single-tile terrain layer. Each character in each row string of the grid array directly corresponds to a key in mapping
field_guide.interaction: Multi-tile interactive object layer. The anchor represents the top-left corner coordinate of the area occupied by the object, and the object extends size-specified tiles to the right (+x) and downward (+y) from that point. Includes: id (unique identifier), category (category), element (references mapping key), anchor (top-left corner coordinates {x,y}), size (occupied tiles {width,height})
field_guide.collision: Collision type for physics behavior. prevent: no collision detection or events; Passive: triggers collision events only, no physical response; Active: full collision with movement response; Fixed: immovable solid object that blocks Active bodies

X.name: space
X.description: empty area, all entities can pass through freely, no collision detection

B.name: brick
B.description: solid block, blocks player/enemy/snowball movement, player can stand and walk on top, cannot be destroyed

-.name: platform
-.description: one-way platform, player/enemy can stand on top, player can jump up through from below, player can drop down by pressing down+jump

P.name: player
P.description: player controlled snowman (Nick or Tom), moves left/right and jumps, shoots snow at enemies to freeze them into snowballs, can push/kick snowballs to eliminate enemies, affected by gravity, collides with brick/platform/enemy, gains temporary invincibility after riding snowball

N.name: enemy
N.description: hostile creature, moves on platforms and chases player, damages player on contact, can be frozen by player snow shots, becomes snowball when fully covered in snow, can be pushed/kicked as snowball to eliminate other enemies, different types have different movement patterns

X.name: space
X.description: empty area, player and guards can move through freely, player and guards will fall through if no platform below

B.name: brick
B.description: solid indestructible block, player and guards can stand and walk on top, permanently blocks movement from sides and below

b.name: diggable_brick
b.description: destructible floor block, player and guards can stand and walk on top, player can dig holes on left or right side (not directly below), holes auto-refill after delay, player dies if trapped in refilling hole

R.name: rope
R.description: horizontal suspended bar, player and guards can grab and shimmy across, player can dig while hanging, player can release by pressing down to fall, allows horizontal traversal over gaps without platform

H.name: ladder
H.description: vertical climbing structure, player and guards can climb up and down, player can dig while standing on ladder, connects different platform levels, player can move left/right to exit ladder at any height

G.name: gold
G.description: collectible, player picks up on contact for points, level incomplete if any gold unreachable

E.name: guard
E.description: chases player, kills player on contact from sides, player can safely walk on guard's head, can climb out of holes
